nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the primary purpose of implementing energy-autonomous technology (EAT) in certain areas?
nodes.answer: The primary purpose of implementing EAT is to promote hygienic facilities in water-scarce or underdeveloped areas where access to conventional sanitation is limited.
